definitions.gloss: skimming scum; removing impurities from cooking liquids
definitions.explanation: the act of removing foam, fat, or impurities that rise to the surface while cooking
a utensil used for removing scum from soups and stews

notes:
{灰汁取|あくと}り has two meanings: the act of skimming scum from cooking liquids, and the utensil used to do so.

COOKING CONTEXT:
⟦{灰汁|あく}→灰汁：13457_aku⟧ (scum/impurities) rises to the surface when boiling meat, vegetables, or making stock. Removing it produces clearer, better-tasting dishes. This is a fundamental technique in Japanese cooking, especially for ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered dishes), ⟦{鍋物|なべもの}→鍋物：14804_nabemono⟧ (hot pot), and ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (stock).

THE UTENSIL:
The {灰汁取|あくと}り tool is a flat, fine-mesh ladle. Common materials include stainless steel and silicone.
